question: The exoplanet TrES-2b stands out among the thousands of worlds discovered so far. What record does it hold?
choices: The most massive planet ever found, far larger than Jupiter
The darkest known planet, reflecting less light than a lump of coal
The fastest-spinning planet, with a day under four hours long
The densest planet known, denser than solid lead
anchorText: reflecting less of the light that strikes it than coal
